feed.title: Molecular Virology lab
feed.subtitle: We investigate how viruses take control of cellular machinery to replicate and spread. Focusing on retroviruses and flaviviruses, we study virus–host interactions and the molecular mechanisms governing viral protein–RNA interactions.

entry.title: 5th NIVB Meeting in Kutná Hora
entry.content:
From November 2–4, 2026, members of our research group attended the 5th National Institute of Virology and Bacteriology (NIVB) Meeting in Kutná Hora, Czech Republic.

The meeting brought together researchers to share recent findings and discuss advances in virology and bacteriology, featuring 30 scientific talks and 40 posters.

Marina Kapisheva contributed to the scientific programme with an oral presentation on retroviral reverse transcriptase. Ivana Křížová participated in management discussions concerning future funding and budgeting of the NIVB project, while prof. Michaela Rumlová participated in a meeting of NIVB research group leaders to discuss the institute’s future plans and priorities.
